decision.rationale: TXN-007881 (179.89 EUR, Quayside Outfitters, card CRD-000209) posted on 2026-10-15. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-31, 16 days later, which is well inside the 120-day time limit. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000011 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-28. The dispute was opened only 3 days after that date. Policy requires the cardholder to wait 15 days after the expected delivery date, because a late parcel can still arrive, and a dispute opened before then is declined. The cardholder may open a new dispute from 2026-11-12, once the waiting period has passed. Because the case ends at the waiting-period step, I did not consider proof of delivery or a merchant refund.

proposed_actions.reason: Your order was expected on 2026-10-28, and this dispute was opened on 2026-10-31, only 3 days later. You need to wait 15 days after the expected delivery date before opening a dispute, in case the parcel arrives late. If it still has not arrived, you can open a new dispute from 2026-11-12.
